The '''River Hos''' is a [[river]] in [[Gielinor]] and runs through [[Hosidius]]. The river's mouth begins west of the [[mess]], and splits into two once it reaches the [[Forthos Ruin]].

Per [[Kharedst's memoirs]] ''The Fisher's Flute'' section, a song named Mist on the River Hos was written after it.

==Crossings==
===By bridge===
*West of the [[mess]] (the river's mouth)
*Behind [[Watson's house]]
*North of the [[Forthos Ruin]]
*West of the [[bank]]
*Near the [[saltpetre]] deposits
*East of [[Kingstown]] park
*East of the [[Arceuus]] church

===By Agility===
*Stepping stones south-east of the [[Infirmary]] and west of [[Watson's house]] (requires 40 [[Agility]])
*Stepping stones west of the allotment patches (requires 45 [[Agility]])

==Fishing spots==
The river has several [[fishing spots]] along it. These are:
*North-west corner of [[Port Piscarilius]]
*East of the [[Hosidius Kitchen]], by the patch of lancalliums
*Outside [[Watson's house]]
*West of the [[charcoal furnace]]s

==Changes==

==Trivia==
* The River Hos did not exist in the launch version of Zeah. It was added as part of the Great Kourend rework to make the continent look more natural.
